summary: This bill amends the Clean Air Act to extend the review period for national ambient air quality standards, allow consideration of attainability when setting standards, provide states more time to correct deficiencies before federal intervention, and modify how certain emissions, like those from wildfires, are accounted for in air quality regulations.

scores.thoughts: This bill, titled the 'Clean Air and Economic Advancement Reform Act,' explicitly amends the Clean Air Act to relax certain environmental regulations and extend compliance timelines. It introduces economic feasibility as a consideration for air quality standards, expands the definition of 'exceptional events' to exclude certain emissions from regulatory penalties, and extends the review period for national ambient air quality standards. These changes are designed to reduce the stringency of air quality regulations, which would lead to less environmental protection.
